Areas of Expertise  /  Technical Support

When something's wrong, start here.

What this looks like

Most support work is same-week, and urgent things get triaged the day you call.

  • Computers and phones: slowdowns, crashes, upgrades, and honest replace-or-repair advice
  • Networks: wifi coverage, routers, wiring, and internet-provider problems
  • Accounts and email: recovery, migration, two-factor setup, and shared-access cleanup
  • Backups: setting them up, testing them, and restoring when you need it
  • Security response: suspected scams, compromised accounts, and what to do next

What you walk away with

The thing works again

Plus a plain explanation of what went wrong, in language you can repeat to someone else.

Notes you keep

What we changed, what to watch for, and what you can safely ignore.

A smaller next problem

We fix the cause where we can, not just the symptom that got your attention.

Need a hand with something specific?

Sliding-scale rates, nonprofit discounts, and a quote before any work starts. The engagement models are on How We Work.
